title: PIMALUOS: multi-agent floor-area optimisation on parcel graphs with planning-scale capacity screens
description: Open-source Python package that builds a multi-relational parcel graph from NYC MapPLUTO, learns parcel embeddings with a self-supervised graph attention network, negotiates lot-level floor-area changes among five stakeholder agents with PPO and weighted plurality voting, screens plans with planning-scale traffic, sewer and solar-access models, and explores trade-offs with NSGA-III. Includes the complete experiment and manuscript-asset pipeline.
